title: Call Me By Your Name
author: André Aciman
current_text: The novel Call Me By Your Name by André Aciman was hidden from sale by the online store Labirint in December 2022. In January 2023 the book was permanently banned from libraries and classrooms in St. Johns County School District, and in September 2023 it was banned from libraries and classrooms in Matanuska-Susitna Borough School District. In June 2025 the state Education Commissioner wrote to the Hillsborough County school district that the book and one other were "pornographic", and the district superintendent was called to a Florida board of education meeting on June 4 about them.
